harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: two CS2R forms whose content the host does not know, read relatively (the consumer's result at the swept distance against the same consumer word 45 cycles later): CS2R.32 R, SR_CgaSize in front of IMAD (the immediate form with -0xa0 and the register form) and the 64-bit CS2R R, SR_GLOBALTIMERLO in front of IMAD (either result register) and IADD.64; anchors: the 64-bit CS2R R, SRZ through the same relative bodies and once through the absolute oracle; every relative request with its positive control (the producer's word behind the first consumer word: it must be wrong) - on a Workstation Edition card, beside a sustained load at the 400-W limit

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
conditions.load: the shipped attention kernel sparse_mla_prefill_v41 (sha256 c896234b...) in its timing loop, a second process on the same card

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
